text.en:
Grants an extra Smoke Bomb Melee Ability Charge.

Cloaking allies grants 50% Melee Energy per ally made invisible.

Wearing Omnioculus grants <pve 50% /> <pvp [10%] /> Damage Resist while invisible.

Being made invisible thanks to an Omnioculus Hunter grants <pve 50% /> <pvp [10%] /> Damage Resist

Wearing Omnioculus and being made invisible by another Omnioculus Hunter grants <pve 75% /> <pvp [19%] /> Damage Resist.

Damage Resistance does not apply in Super.

Grants an extra Smoke Bomb Melee Ability Charge.

Void Invisibility grants <pve 50% /> <pvp [10%] /> Damage Resist.

Cloaking allies grants them the same Damage Resist benefits and refunds 50% Melee Ability Energy per ally made invisible.

Damage Resistance does not apply while in Super.
